C1199.title: Man Detained for Using AI Deepfake of KMT Chairperson Cheng Li-wen in Livestream Sales
keywords: Ministry of Public Security Cyber Bureau
C1199.summary: The Cyber Security Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security disclosed that a netizen surnamed Xing from Datong, Shanxi, used AI tools to generate a digital persona of Cheng Li-wen for unauthorized livestream sales, sparking public concern and causing a severe negative impact.
